details: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) has approved Kalshi's bitcoin perpetual futures contract (BTCPERP), marking the establishment of a regulated onshore venue for crypto perpetuals. This allows U.S. traders to speculate on Bitcoin's future price without a fixed expiration, expanding institutional access to derivatives and risk management tools.
title: CFTC Approves First Regulated U.S. Bitcoin Perpetual Futures Contract on Kalshi.

details: The Gravity Bridge, a cross-chain protocol connecting the Ethereum and Cosmos ecosystems, experienced an exploit resulting in the loss of approximately $5.4 million. On-chain analysts identified suspicious outflows, leading to the suspension of validator operations. The stolen assets included USDC, wrapped ETH, Tether, and PAX Gold, with some funds routed through Binance and ChangeNow.
title: Gravity Bridge Halted After $5.4M Ethereum-Cosmos Drain.

details: VanEck has introduced the first US-listed spot BNB exchange-traded fund (VBNB) on Nasdaq, providing regulated exposure to Binance's native token. This development, combined with Binance's 65th HODLer Airdrop (Genius Terminal), has contributed to a notable price increase for BNB, reflecting growing institutional interest and robust engagement within its ecosystem.
title: VanEck Launches First US Spot BNB ETF, Boosting Ecosystem.

details: The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) has charged Nathan Fuller, founder of Privvy Investments LLC, with orchestrating a $12.3 million cryptocurrency fraud. Fuller allegedly deceived around 150 investors by promising high returns from non-existent AI-based trading bots, while diverting the majority of funds for personal use and Ponzi-like payments.
title: SEC Charges Privvy Founder With $12.3M Crypto Fraud Scheme.

details: XRP Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) have continued to attract substantial investor capital, with total net inflows reaching $1.42 billion. This trend is noteworthy as it occurs while Bitcoin and Ethereum ETFs are experiencing outflows, indicating a divergence in institutional interest and strong sustained demand for XRP-related investment products.
title: XRP ETFs See $1.42 Billion Inflows, Outperforming BTC & ETH.

details: CME Group has expanded its cryptocurrency futures and options trading to operate 24/7 on its Globex platform. This move eliminates previous weekend closures and provides continuous access for institutional and active traders to manage risk across various digital asset derivatives, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, and XRP.
title: CME Group Rolls Out 24/7 Trading for Crypto Futures & Options.
